CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_source_locators (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	locator BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision, ordinal) REFERENCES pc_artifact_lineage_sources (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision, ordinal) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
